messages.subject: ESG & Sustainability Executive | External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Weinreb Group Team,

Your retained search focus on Chief Sustainability Officers, ESG executives and sustainability leadership aligns directly with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where ESG strategy must translate into measurable operational, regulatory and stakeholder outcomes. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
